scope: first paired Full-KV versus Route-A control-projection DC feasibility only

constraints.output_load_interpretation: lightweight top-level feasibility load; not HBM, package, PHY, or system-interconnect load

library.selection_scope: existing H3 feasibility-library inheritance only; not a PPA library/corner sweep

constraint_coverage_rule.clock: exactly one port named clock; excluded from input delay and transition
constraint_coverage_rule.reset: exactly one port named reset; treated as an ordinary synchronous input
constraint_coverage_rule.inputs: all top inputs other than clock receive input delay and transition
constraint_coverage_rule.outputs: all top outputs receive output delay and load

array_interiors.S2: s2_payload_access_v1 plus Route-A s2_sidecar_access_v1; retain READY/four-consumer/release/fault control
array_interiors.rule: only the array interior may become a generic black-box or later macro proxy; no whole-array view, parent control, adapter, mux, fanout, or state may disappear

external_services.rule: the current projections expose these as real typed top ports; a later DC harness may add only interface-conformant boundary stubs and must retain their nonzero/unestimated cost classification

array_and_external_boundary_rule.cost_rule: no array or external service is zero-cost, and S2 remains non-cancellable
